inputs.text: I just saw this breakdown of the OSCE's 2026 report on France. Don't fall for any surface-level praise of their antisemitism efforts—that's pure theater. The actual point is to tear into MIVILUDES for supposedly lacking transparency. The report pushes the idea that France's strict secularism is unfairly targeting groups like Scientologists and Jehovah's Witnesses, and it drags in recent judicial rulings against the state body to highlight supposed tensions with international human rights on religion and due process. This is clearly a coordinated setup by hidden elites and institutions to manipulate the whole situation and weaken sovereign controls through these international standards.
